description: Fix broken ModelSelect popover (Headless UI v2 Transition issue) and improve AI settings page layout

tasks.title: Fix ModelSelect popover and reorder AI settings layout
tasks.description: In AiSettingsSection.tsx: (1) Remove the Transition wrapper around Popover.Panel in ModelSelect (lines 257-265, 322), remove unused Transition and Fragment imports. (2) Reorder the AiSettingsSection JSX so Model Selection and Stage Model Overrides appear before Providers. (3) Split the Providers section: show connected providers always, collapse unconfigured providers behind a toggle with count (e.g. '80 providers available'). Add a showUnconfigured state variable for the toggle.
acceptanceCriteria: ModelSelect popover opens when clicking the button (Popover.Panel renders to DOM)
Search and model selection work inside the popover
Stage Model Override selectors open and function correctly
Model Selection section renders before the Providers section on the page
Connected providers display with Remove buttons at the top of the Providers section
Unconfigured providers are collapsed by default with a count label
Clicking the collapsed row expands to show unconfigured providers with search
tasks.notes: All three changes are in the same file and tightly coupled — layout reorder affects the same JSX that references the fixed ModelSelect, and the provider grouping is part of the same section reorder.
